name: Get Deleted Leads
summary: Pulls the record of leads that were deleted from Marketo, after a given point in time.
whenToUse: For audits: find out which leads were deleted and when. Requires a paging token (see Get Paging Token).

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Paging token
query.hint: Get one from 'Get Paging Token' (for a start date) or copy it from a previous response to continue paging.

response.description: Up to 300 deletion records per page: leadId, activityDate, primaryAttributeValue (often the lead's name).

notes: Keep paging with nextPageToken until moreResult is false.
